passives.name: Energized
passives.effects: Moving and basic attacking generates Energize stacks, up to 100.

passives.name: Electroshock

passives.name: Electrospark
passives.effects: When fully Energized, your next basic attack on-hit is empowered to form chain lightning, dealing 60 bonus magic damage, increased to 90 magic damage against non-champions. This bounces to the closest target within 500 units, repeating from the new target to strike up to 1 – 20 (based on level) targets, dealing the same damage and applying on-hit effects to secondary targets hit.
